firm_data.firm_description: Lebedin Kofman LLP is a boutique law firm providing high-quality legal services. They offer 24/7 availability and focus on giving clients personalized attention.
notable_facts: Offers free attorney consultations via phone, video conferencing, or in person
Located in front of the charging bull on Broadway

email.subject: AI for Lebedin Kofman LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Arthur,

Your focus on personalized attention and 24/7 availability for criminal defense and DWI cases puts you ahead of most firms, but it also means your team is stretched thin managing client needs round the clock.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
